name: intake_required_documents
description: The document types an intake claim is checked for (Story 2.2). A separate document from derivation_thresholds because this is not a derivation parameter: services/claims owns the checklist, and the registry's parameter block is what every derivation is built from. Version 1 is the prototype's FROI/INCIDENT/MEDAUTH/WAGE set. Note the seam: the statutory per-path form list (path_required_form) is Story 2.5's reference data and a different surface — this list is what a handler must have on file before intake is complete, not what a jurisdiction requires.
